summary: This procedure works out the two tax amounts on one customer's bill: an energy duty based on the energy charge, and a GST based on the energy charge, the fixed charge, the fuel charge and that energy duty.

rules.text: The energy duty is 1.5% of the energy charge, rounded to 2 decimal places.
The GST is 17% of the sum of the energy charge, the fixed charge, the fuel charge and the energy duty, rounded to 2 decimal places.
The GST is calculated on the energy duty as well, so the energy duty is taxed again within the GST base.
There are no conditions, lookups or error handling in this procedure, so the taxes are always calculated the same way for every bill passed to it.
